notes:
v4.6.82 — IBKR cloud start fixes

🐛 FIXED
• “Cloud start failed: Read timed out” — starting an IBKR bot on the cloud cold-boots the server gateway (login + API init can take up to ~90s). The desktop only waited 15s. It now waits long enough (and tells you the cold start can take a bit).
• IBKR bots now run on the cloud whenever you've enabled “Run IBKR bots on Oracle” — a freshly-added IBKR bot no longer falls through to the local path and fails with “IB Gateway not reachable”.
• That local-gateway popup is now a clear prompt to enable cloud (Tools → IBKR → “Run IBKR bots on Oracle”) instead of telling you to start a local TWS you don't run.

ℹ️ To run IBKR bots: Tools → IBKR → tick “Run IBKR bots on Oracle” and save your IBKR login. (Server-side fixes for the gateway boot were already deployed.)

Update via the in-app banner.
